create_Conj_constraint: create a Conj constraint to combine multiple tensor type constraints with logical AND
create_Disj_constraint: create a Disj constraint to combine multiple tensor type constraints with logical OR
build_BinConstraintT: build a BinConstraintT to express binary operations between tensor variables and tensor types
create_CalcConv_constraint: create a CalcConv constraint to represent convolution output shape and type relationships
create_TVar_DVar: create TVar and DVar instances to represent tensor and dimension variables in constraint expressions
